# Idempotence Check for Compile Runs

A compile run for a (repo, pr) must be succeeded to allow re-trigger; otherwise, it is a no-op.

To prevent unnecessary recompilation and maintain system efficiency.

- `knowledge_compiler/storage/schema.py` — `knowledge_compiler.storage.schema.CompileRun`
